  body: (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x636f6e74657874) then 0x372e3220556e6465727374616e64696e6720616e642073706563696679696e672074686520636f6e74657874206f6620757365 else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x726571756972656d656e7473) then 0x372e332053706563696679696e6720746865207573657220726571756972656d656e7473 else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x736f6c7574696f6e73) then 0x372e342050726f647563696e672064657369676e20736f6c7574696f6e73 else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x6576616c756174696f6e) then 0x372e35204576616c756174696e67207468652064657369676e else 0x))))
}

  parameters: [activity : Bytes],

  body: (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x636f6e74657874) then 0x53747564696f2e4f627365727665722c206120736f73613a4f62736572766174696f6e206f662065616368207061727469636970616e7420696e20746865206a6f75726e657920746865792074616b65207061727420696e else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x726571756972656d656e7473) then 0x53747564696f2e466565646261636b2c2074686520706c617965727327206d61736b656420666565646261636b2064697374696c6c656420627920636f6e73656e737573 else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x736f6c7574696f6e73) then 0x53747564696f2e507269736d47656e65726174696f6e2c2074686520507269736d2067656e6572617465642066726f6d20697473207365656420616e64207468652066656174757265732069742069732074756e656420746f else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x6576616c756174696f6e) then 0x53747564696f2e4775692e4163636573736962696c69747920616e642053747564696f2e4775692e55736162696c697479206f766572206576657279207669657720747265652c207769746820736174697366616374696f6e2066726f6d2053747564696f2e466565646261636b else 0x))))

definition{
  name: next,
  parameters: [activity : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x636f6e74657874) then 0x726571756972656d656e7473 else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x726571756972656d656e7473) then 0x736f6c7574696f6e73 else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x736f6c7574696f6e73) then 0x6576616c756174696f6e else (if (Studio.Runtime::same activity 0x6576616c756174696f6e) then 0x636f6e74657874 else 0x))))
}

definition{
  name: stage,
  parameters: [activity : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append (prim append (prim append (prim append (prim append (prim append activity 0x3a2049534f20393234312d3231303a3230313920 : Bytes) (clause activity) : Bytes) 0x2028696e666572726564292c2063617272696564206f757420627920 : Bytes) (carrier activity) : Bytes) 0x3b206e6578743a20 : Bytes) (next activity) : Bytes) 0x0a : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: cycle,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append (prim append (prim append (stage 0x636f6e74657874) (stage 0x726571756972656d656e7473) : Bytes) (stage 0x736f6c7574696f6e73) : Bytes) (stage 0x6576616c756174696f6e) : Bytes)  : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: refusal,
  parameters: [activity : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append 0x726566757365643a20 activity : Bytes) 0x206973206e6f2068756d616e2d63656e747265642064657369676e206163746976697479206f662049534f20393234312d3231303a3230313920636c6175736520373b2074686520616374697669746965732061726520636f6e746578742c20726571756972656d656e74732c20736f6c7574696f6e7320616e64206576616c756174696f6e : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: request,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374
    | List.cons mode rest => (if (Studio.Runtime::same mode 0x6379636c65) then (cycle) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same mode 0x7374616765) then (match rest
      | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374
      | List.cons activity more => (if ((prim length (clause activity) : Nat) =? 0) then (refusal activity) else (stage activity))) else 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)))
}
